import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { Box, Paper, Typography, TextField, Button, Grid, Container, Alert, Snackbar, Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableContainer, TableHead, TableRow, Checkbox, FormControlLabel, Modal, IconButton, Stack } from '@mui/material'; import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close'; import axios from 'axios'; function CostCalculator() { const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ scale: { consumers_per_tenant: 3, total_tenants: 5000, endpoints_per_tenant: 10000 }, cloud_provider: 'aws' }); const [scaleConfigEnabled, setScaleConfigEnabled] = useState(false); const [scaleConfigModalOpen, setScaleConfigModalOpen] = useState(false); const [networkLoadEnabled, setNetworkLoadEnabled] = useState(false); const [networkLoadModalOpen, setNetworkLoadModalOpen] = useState(false); const [networkLoadConfig, setNetworkLoadConfig] = useState({ api: { calls_per_day: 189, request_size_mb: 1.076 }, messages: { events_per_day: 100010, message_size_kb: 1 } }); const [costBreakdown, setCostBreakdown] = useState(null); const [notification, setNotification] = useState({ open: false, message: '', severity: 'success' }); const handleInputChange = (field, value) => { setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, scale: { ...prev.scale, [field]: parseInt(value) || 0 } })); }; const handleScaleConfigChange = (event) => { setScaleConfigEnabled(event.target.checked); if (event.target.checked) { setScaleConfigModalOpen(true); } }; const handleNetworkLoadChange = (event) => { setNetworkLoadEnabled(event.target.checked); if (event.target.checked) { setNetworkLoadModalOpen(true); } }; const handleNetworkConfigChange = (category, field, value) => { setNetworkLoadConfig(prev => ({ ...prev, [category]: { ...prev[category], [field]: parseFloat(value) || 0 } })); }; const modalStyle = { position: 'absolute', top: '50%', left: '50%', transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)', width: '80%', maxWidth: 800, bgcolor: 'background.paper', boxShadow: 24, p: 4, borderRadius: 2, maxHeight: '90vh', overflow: 'auto' }; const calculateCosts = async () => { try { const requestData = { ...formData, network_load: networkLoadEnabled ? networkLoadConfig : null }; const response = await axios.post('http://localhost:8000/calculate-cost', requestData); setCostBreakdown(response.data); setNotification({ open: true, message: 'Cost calculation successful!', severity: 'success' }); } catch (error) { setNotification({ open: true, message: 'Error calculating costs: ' + (error.response?.data?.detail || error.message), severity: 'error' }); } }; const handleCloseNotification = () => { setNotification({ ...notification, open: false }); }; const formatCurrency = (value) => { return `$${value.toFixed(2)}`; }; return ( PxGrid Cloud Cost Calculator } label="Configure Scale Parameters" /> } label="Configure Network Load" /> setScaleConfigModalOpen(false)} > Scale Parameters Configuration setScaleConfigModalOpen(false)} size="small"> S.No Scale Parameters Count 1 Cloud consumer per Tenant handleInputChange('consumers_per_tenant', e.target.value)} size="small" inputProps={{ min: 1 }} /> 2 Total Tenant handleInputChange('total_tenants', e.target.value)} size="small" inputProps={{ min: 1 }} /> 3 Total End-points per Tenant handleInputChange('endpoints_per_tenant', e.target.value)} size="small" inputProps={{ min: 1 }} />
setNetworkLoadModalOpen(false)} > Network Load Configuration setNetworkLoadModalOpen(false)} size="small"> API Configuration handleNetworkConfigChange('api', 'calls_per_day', e.target.value)} size="small" /> handleNetworkConfigChange('api', 'request_size_mb', e.target.value)} size="small" /> Message Events Configuration handleNetworkConfigChange('messages', 'events_per_day', e.target.value)} size="small" /> handleNetworkConfigChange('messages', 'message_size_kb', e.target.value)} size="small" /> {costBreakdown && ( {scaleConfigEnabled && ( Scale Parameters Summary Parameter Value Total Impact Cloud Consumers {formData.scale.consumers_per_tenant} per tenant {formData.scale.consumers_per_tenant * formData.scale.total_tenants} total Tenants {formData.scale.total_tenants} - Endpoints {formData.scale.endpoints_per_tenant} per tenant {formData.scale.endpoints_per_tenant * formData.scale.total_tenants} total
)} {networkLoadEnabled && ( Network Load Metrics Metric Per Consumer Total (All Tenants) API Calls {networkLoadConfig.api.calls_per_day.toLocaleString()} calls/day {(networkLoadConfig.api.calls_per_day * formData.scale.consumers_per_tenant * formData.scale.total_tenants).toLocaleString()} calls/day API Data Size {networkLoadConfig.api.request_size_mb.toFixed(3)} MB/request {((networkLoadConfig.api.calls_per_day * networkLoadConfig.api.request_size_mb * formData.scale.consumers_per_tenant * formData.scale.total_tenants) / 1024).toFixed(2)} GB/day Message Events {networkLoadConfig.messages.events_per_day.toLocaleString()} events/day {(networkLoadConfig.messages.events_per_day * formData.scale.consumers_per_tenant * formData.scale.total_tenants).toLocaleString()} events/day Message Data Size {networkLoadConfig.messages.message_size_kb} KB/message {((networkLoadConfig.messages.events_per_day * networkLoadConfig.messages.message_size_kb * formData.scale.consumers_per_tenant * formData.scale.total_tenants) / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} GB/day
)} Cost Breakdown (Monthly) PxGrid Costs {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.breakdown.pxgrid_cost)} Storage Costs DynamoDB: {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.breakdown.storage.dynamodb_cost)} S3: {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.breakdown.storage.s3_cost)} Container Costs {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.breakdown.container_cost)} Network Costs Throughput: {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.breakdown.network.throughput_cost)} MSK: {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.breakdown.network.msk_cost)} Total Monthly Cost: {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.total_cost)} Cost per Tenant: {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.monthly_cost_per_tenant)} )} {notification.message} ); } export default CostCalculator;
